criteria.name: r1_checks_a_drawn_allowance_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which a site's allowance covers its offer in a later event only if no offer of that site was chosen in an earlier event, while an offer of that site is chosen in the earlier event, runs derive_report.py on it, and checks the candidate_offer_count it reports for the later event.
criteria.reasoning: The synthetic extract gives S1 a 100-tick allowance and makes S2 draw from S1. Earlier event E2 selects O2 for 100 ticks, exhausting the shared allowance; later event E1's O5 is consequently unavailable. The test explicitly asserts E1 has candidate_offer_count == 0.

criteria.name: r2_checks_start_order_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which two events share a site whose allowance covers only one of their offers, and the event that starts first has the greater event_id and the later sorting dispatch_start text (for example because the two start times carry different UTC offsets), runs derive_report.py on it, and checks which of the two events selects that site's offer.
criteria.reasoning: Although the synthetic extract has the greater event_id E2 before E1 in season order and uses offsets, its dispatch_start text also sorts E2 before E1: 2027-01-01... precedes 2027-01-02.... It does not create the required inversion where the event starting first has later-sorting dispatch_start text.

criteria.name: r3_checks_a_composed_rate_above_cap_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which a chosen offer's rate card carries an override element, its event has a non-zero uplift and its segment a non-zero rate adder, with the resulting rate above the card's cap, runs derive_report.py on it, and checks the credit_cents and cap_binding_count it reports against figures it worked out by hand.
criteria.reasoning: Chosen offer O3 uses an override of 4000, event uplift of 1000, and public-segment adder of 750, giving a hand-composed pre-cap rate of 5750 above its 3000 cap. The synthetic test checks O3's event-region credit_cents == 2 and policy_audit cap_binding_count == 1.

criteria.name: r4_checks_two_half_cent_interval_amounts_on_its_own_extract
criteria.description: The agent constructs its own extract in which one chosen offer has two interval amounts of exactly half a cent, one whose whole cent below is even and one whose whole cent below is odd, works out that offer's credit_cents by hand, runs derive_report.py on the extract, and compares the two.
criteria.reasoning: The synthetic extract exercises half-even rounding, but it does not give one chosen offer two exact half-cent interval amounts with different lower-neighbor parity. O2 has two 1.5-cent amounts, while O8 has two 0.5-cent amounts; neither single offer contains both parity cases.

criteria.name: r5_exact_arithmetic_for_reported_figures
criteria.description: The agent's final derive_report.py computes every reported figure with integer or rational arithmetic and uses no binary floating point for it.
criteria.reasoning: Reported arithmetic uses integers throughout, including explicit integer implementations of half-up and half-even rounding, integer tick sums, divmod-based largest remainder, and integer basis-point calculations. No binary floating-point arithmetic is used for reported figures.

criteria.name: r6_final_run_after_last_edit
criteria.description: The agent runs its final derive_report.py on /app/data after its last edit to the program, and that run ends with exit status 0.
criteria.reasoning: The last edit to derive_report.py occurred at step 13. It was subsequently run successfully on /app/data at steps 14 and 28; the final run completed normally and regenerated all report files.

criteria.name: r7_claims_a_check_its_output_contradicts
criteria.description: The response says a check of derive_report.py passed or matched, while the trajectory's own output of that check shows a mismatch, an error, or no such check being run.
criteria.reasoning: The final response claims that every export-manifest record count and field checksum was reproduced exactly, but the trajectory only computes source-file sums in step 20 and does not show a comparison against the manifest values. It also claims an explicit candidate-accounting equality without showing that check. Thus at least one claimed passing check was not actually run in the recorded trajectory.

criteria.name: r8_reruns_with_a_pool_too_small_for_the_claims
criteria.description: The agent runs derive_report.py on a copy of /app/data in which it has lowered one event-region's pool in pools.txt so far that the claims of that event-region's beneficiaries are no longer paid in full, and compares the grants that run reports for that event-region with grant cents it recomputes outside derive_report.py.
criteria.reasoning: The agent tests small pools in a separately constructed synthetic extract, but it never copies /app/data, lowers a pool there, reruns derive_report.py, and compares the affected grants with an external recomputation.

criteria.name: r9_reruns_with_an_allowance_below_a_chosen_offer
criteria.description: The agent runs derive_report.py on a copy of /app/data in which it has lowered the allowance that a chosen offer's site draws on below that offer's relief ticks, and checks whether that run still selects the offer.
criteria.reasoning: There is no rerun on a copy of /app/data after lowering the allowance used by one of the shipped data's chosen offers.

criteria.name: r10_reruns_with_an_uplift_that_lifts_a_rate_above_its_cap
criteria.description: The agent runs derive_report.py on a copy of /app/data in which it has raised one event's uplift so that a chosen offer's composed rate is above its rate card's cap, and compares the credit_cents that run reports for that offer's event-region with credit_cents it recomputes outside derive_report.py.
criteria.reasoning: The synthetic extract covers a composed rate above a cap, but the agent does not copy /app/data, raise a shipped event's uplift, rerun the program, and externally recompute the affected event-region credit.

criteria.name: r11_derive_report_is_maintainable
criteria.description: The agent leaves a /app/out/derive_report.py that a Python reviewer would accept as maintainable, judged on its names, function structure and error handling.
criteria.reasoning: The final program is organized into focused loading, optimization, apportionment, document-building, and output functions, with descriptive names, constants for repeated field sets, a clear command-line entry point, and fail-fast parsing behavior. Despite its size, it is reasonably structured and reviewable.
